usage.guide: Cannot be tested as-is: the QA task header and the machine spec disagree on the call URL (x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/tts vs x402.dellbot.win/tts-nano), and the money-safety classifier refused to pay the spec URL because it did not match the task-authorized URL. To proceed, a human must confirm the canonical endpoint URL. Once confirmed, call POST <canonical-url> with x402 payment (~$0.005 USDC on Base) and a JSON body like {"text":"hello how are you?"}; the response is expected to be raw audio bytes. The inputSchema is null so the {text} field name is unverified.
